Name: max_len
Comment: RB hard limit - overall length must be under this (handbook 2)

Name: max_width
Comment: RB hard limit - overall width must be UNDER 2 m (handbook 2)

Name: max_height
Comment: RB hard limit - overall height must be under this (handbook 2)

Name: mass_limit
Comment: RB CONFIRMED max race mass EXCLUDING driver (handbook 2) - binding

Name: min_ground_clearance
Comment: RB min ground clearance (UK rules); we design to 150 (handbook 2)

Name: wheelbase
Comment: Front-to-rear axle spacing; track ~0.70x wheelbase = stable ratio

Name: track_width
Comment: Left-right wheel centreline spacing - CAPPED at 1200 by builder

Name: wheel_dia
Comment: Rybro 260 pneumatic OD (25 mm fixed bore T019 2.1); sets axle line at 130 mm

Name: wheel_width
Comment: Single tyre section width

Name: rear_dual_gap
Comment: Gap between the two paired rear tyres (dual-rear truck layout)

Name: rear_pair_width
Comment: Total width of one rear dual pair = 195 mm

Name: axle_height
Comment: Axle centreline height above ground = 130 mm (sits below the 150 deck line on drop-brackets)

Name: ground_clearance
Comment: Chassis underside to ground; nose set higher (~180) for ramp lip

Name: overall_width_calc
Comment: Approx overall width over rear duals = 1395 mm (< max_width OK)

Name: body_width
Comment: Shell width - sits inboard of the wheels; narrow heater read

Name: body_height
Comment: Shell height - tall heater

Name: body_length_main
Comment: Main heater-box length before the boat-tail

Name: body_front_x
Comment: X of the main box flat front face (longitudinal datum); dome apex = body_front_x + front_dome_depth. See T018 3.1

Name: boattail_len
Comment: Rear taper length into the gas-bottle driver pod

Name: overall_length_calc
Comment: Approx overall length incl domed nose = 2550 mm (< max_len OK)

Name: body_rake
Comment: Slight backward lean; main aero comes from the domed front + boat-tail

Name: front_dome_depth
Comment: How far the convex front face bows forward at mid-height

Name: driver_height
Comment: 95th-percentile male standing height (design driver)

Name: driver_mass
Comment: 95th-percentile male mass (NOT counted in the 80 kg cart limit)

Name: shoulder_width
Comment: Clothed shoulder breadth - sets cockpit and roll-hoop width

Name: driver_pkg_len
Comment: Reclined driver package length along X (feet forward)

Name: driver_center_x
Comment: Driver/torso centre X aft of mid-wheelbase; TUNABLE - adjust for 45-55% front balance (C3). Used by T020 under-seat cross member and T023/T025 pod

Name: recline_angle
Comment: Torso recline from horizontal - low CoG

Name: seat_pan_z
Comment: Top of seat pan above ground - hips low for CoG

Name: driver_cg_z
Comment: Target driver mass-centre height - dominates total CoG

Name: head_top_z
Comment: Top of helmet when reclined - sets roll-hoop height

Name: roll_clearance
Comment: Min helmet-to-roll-structure gap (S2)

Name: roll_hoop_z
Comment: Roll-hoop apex height = 1150 mm (above helmet

Name: cog_target_z
Comment: Max allowable CoG height for anti-tip (C1) = 540 mm

Name: steering_lock
Comment: Max steer angle each side - sets turning radius

Name: disc_dia
Comment: Rear brake disc diameter (one per side

Name: kingpin_track
Comment: Kingpin centre spacing (slightly inboard of wheel centres)

Name: caster_angle
Comment: Kingpin rearward lean for self-centring (T021 2; keep 3-5)

Name: rear_axle_dia
Comment: Central rear-axle section (stepped axle option A T019 5.4); stub ends stay 25 mm to match wheel bore

Name: frame_tube
Comment: Spine/hoop square-tube size (1.6-2 mm wall); sets the deck stack (T020 3.1)

Name: deck_thickness
Comment: Shutterply deck thickness (T020 3.2)

Name: deck_top_z
Comment: Top of the ply deck = 192 mm; longeron underside sits AT ground_clearance (T020 3.1 stack)

Name: harness_bar_z
Comment: Harness cross-bar height on the roll hoop = driver shoulder height; straps must run 0-40 deg DOWN behind the shoulders never up to the apex (T025 4)

Name: pod_end_dia
Comment: Boat-tail end cross-section (approx circle) at X = -1150; reads as the gas-bottle pod (T023 3.3)

Name: pod_center_z
Comment: Height of the pod end-section centre; bottom edge 300 clears the rear duals (T023 3.3)

Name: view_band_lo
Comment: Bottom of the see-through mesh band in the front face - driver sightline to road ~5 m ahead of the nose (T023 3.2 / T025 5)

Name: view_band_hi
Comment: Top of the see-through mesh band; reads as the heater upper grille (T023 3.2)

Name: wheelwell_clearance
Comment: Min gap shell/deck to any tyre surface incl full steering sweep (T023 3.6)
